tool.name: vectorbt
tool.role: point-in-time daily-bar signal research and moving-average computation

methodology.overlapping_events: allowed; this is a signal study, not portfolio P&L
methodology.lookahead_control: signals use only information available at signal close; future bars are used only for ex-post evaluation

strategy_definitions.ma20_reclaim: Close crosses from at/below MA20 to above MA20.
strategy_definitions.ma20_above_ma60_entry: First day a regime has close > MA20 > MA60.
strategy_definitions.breakout_20d_close: First close above the highest close of the prior 20 sessions.
strategy_definitions.pullback_ma20_after_breakout: Within 10 sessions after a 20-day breakout, price touches within 1% above MA20 and closes at/above MA20 while above MA60.
strategy_definitions.volume_confirmed_20d_breakout: 20-day close breakout with volume > 1.2x 20-day volume MA.

production_use.privacy_boundary: Public research scopes do not assert or encode private holding status.
production_use.instruction: Use these statistics to calibrate human analysis. Do not convert them into automatic trades or exact action prices without current-market confirmation and portfolio context.

statistical_evidence_layer.method: constant-only OLS on signal forward returns with HAC/Newey-West covariance
statistical_evidence_layer.interpretation: A historical mean estimate must survive both uncertainty reporting and the payload-level FDR gate before it is classed as positive or negative statistical evidence. This is still not a forecast, causal claim, or automatic action trigger.
statistical_evidence_layer.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction is applied across all sufficient signal-horizon tests in this payload.
